note.label: The Truth Behind Christmas and New Years

points: “Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judea in the days of Herod the king”. This Herod is Herod the Great, an Edomite. Herod married into the Hasmonean house. Mariamne, a Hasmonean princess, he killed, and her children with her; Doris and her son he killed too, to make sure he solidified his place as leader. Rome did not care as long as it got its tribute. He positioned himself, the snake he is. Esau, Edom, Amalek and Rome are the same spirit, joined together.

Rome is ruling now. “When Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judea in the days of Herod the king”. How is the white man the king of Judea? We just read the history. His father Antipater set him up; Antipater had a position in the court of the Hasmoneans, and the Hasmoneans go back to the Maccabean family. We promoted Esau into our courts, Herod married a black woman who was a royal princess and killed her, and Rome said, you and your family are going to govern Judea.

If the messiah were coming to save all nations, there would be nothing in his birth to trouble a ruler of the nations. Herod is troubled because the coming of the messiah to Israel means judgment upon those who hold Israel down.
